BEYOND THE STICKER

Four things worth knowing.

01

You might need no new console.

Owners of supported PS5 and Xbox Series X|S systems already have the main piece of hardware.

02

Xbox One gets a cloud route.

Xbox announced launch-day cloud streaming to Xbox One. Streaming is a separate expense and subject to market and account availability.

03

Single-player is not an online subscription.

The base campaign is a single-player experience with offline play on PlayStation. Do not automatically add PS Plus or GTA+ to the minimum cost.

04

Resale isn't money in your pocket yet.

A future resale price is speculative. Our receipt keeps that projection separate from today's purchase.

THE METHODOLOGY

No mystery numbers.

Every published price has a source and verification date. User quotations are marked as such. Unknown tax, hardware, or cloud fees remain unresolved until entered. No registration, cookies, third-party analytics, or external fonts. The calculation runs in your browser.

Evidence log is included in the project source package
01

Verified PlayStation and Xbox storefront prices for the US, France, and UK.

02

Integer-based arithmetic, with tests for taxes, unknowns, cloud packs, and projected resale.

03

Shareable URL state with no identity or location tracking.

04

No official GTA art, branding assets, or claim of affiliation.
